name: fleet-ref-rust
note: Rust reference fleet: mike itself at a pinned commit in the long-lived slot .claude/worktrees/fleet-ref, which keeps its target/ between runs (one cold build, never seeded by a copy). prepare checks the slot out on a new branch at `pin`, reverts `answers` on it in one commit, and builds nothing. The known answers are those commits: scripts/fleet-ref keeps them out of the briefs. T4, T5 and T6 are in crates/mike-features/src/launch/fleet, so the shared tree and commit-before-branch paths are exercised; T1 (mike-mcp), T2 (api) and T3 (frontend) are in different crates and areas. All six reverts apply cleanly one after another (checked with git merge-tree on 2026-10-21).
duration_minutes: 60 to 90 on omit after the first build; not on the Mac

definition.goal: Six small changes that mike once had are made again, each with its test passing: get_fleet_record, a starting seat kept by define_fleet, capability banner fix links, fleet definition scope checks, checks queued on their own checkout, and small slice-report receipts.

coordinator.brief: A Rust reference run of six small tasks in mike; nothing here needs the operator. Use the project's operations: cargo builds run at the capacity its operations.json declares.

acceptance.brief: Each task's brief ends with a done_when command; run it at the reported commit and record the verdict.

goals.workers: task {task} ({name}) has its own commit, exercise evidence and fleet_report for {criteria}, with the done_when command in its brief shown passing in its own output; or stop after 30 turns

rules: Nothing outside the task's files is changed.
Do not read git history for the task's change: describe it from the brief.

T1.name: get_fleet_record tool
T1.brief: Fleet reference task. Read .claude/fleet/project.md first. Add the MCP tool get_fleet_record to crates/mike-mcp: it reads GET /api/fleets/{fleet}/record on the inspect API through a new InspectClient method in client/fleets.rs. Arguments: fleet (slug or uuid, required), against (another run to compare with, optional) and recompute (bool, optional); against and recompute go on the query string only when given. An unknown fleet answers with an error that names the fleet. Mark the inspect route as covered in crates/mike-features/src/api/manifest/fleets.rs and describe the tool in docs/MCP_BRIDGE.md. Register it in tools.rs, tools/catalogue.rs, tools/dispatch.rs and profiles.rs the way the neighbouring fleet tools are, in the new file tools/fleet_record.rs, with tests in tools/fleet_record_tests.rs named get_fleet_record_reads_the_stored_record_without_a_query, get_fleet_record_passes_against_and_recompute, get_fleet_record_names_the_fleet_when_it_is_unknown and the_tool_takes_fleet_against_and_recompute. Done when `scripts/cx nextest run -p mike-mcp fleet_record` exits 0 and `scripts/cx nextest run -p mike-mcp --test manifest_coverage` exits 0.

T2.name: define_fleet keeps a starting seat
T2.brief: Fleet reference task. Read .claude/fleet/project.md first. A task's state is `starting` from the moment staff claims it until the seat opens or fails. A define_fleet patch that clears its seat or session, or removes the task, while it is `starting` made the task ready again and mike started a second seat for it. Refuse such a patch in api/fleet/definition_patch.rs (InvalidDefinition) with a message that names the task, says mike is starting a seat for it and what to wait for; clearing a seat in any other state and renaming a starting task stay allowed. Test: clearing_a_seat_mike_is_still_starting_is_refused in api/fleet/definition_tests.rs. Done when `scripts/cx nextest run -p mike --lib clearing_a_seat_mike_is_still_starting_is_refused` exits 0.

T3.name: Capability banner fix links
T3.brief: Fleet reference task. Read .claude/fleet/project.md first. The home page capability banner prints each fix as plain text, so "Add credit at https://openrouter.ai/settings/credits" and "Enable embedding.enabled at /settings/embedding" name a place without a way to go there. Add frontend/src/lib/components/home/fixLinks.ts exporting fixSegments(text): it splits fix text into segments, an external URL becomes a link segment (opened in a new tab) with the sentence's closing full stop kept as text, an in-app path (a slash-led path) becomes an internal link segment, a slash inside a word is not a path, and text without links comes back as one text segment. Render the segments in CapabilityBanner.svelte. Cover it in fixLinks.test.ts (describe fixSegments, four cases). Done when `scripts/sb-test` runs the fixLinks tests green; do not run the whole Storybook suite while another seat does.

T4.name: Fleet definition scope checks
T4.brief: Fleet reference task. Read .claude/fleet/project.md first. check_definition (launch/fleet/checks.rs) should list as missing (a) a task whose brief asks for a live exercise (words live, served, running app, in the app, matched as whole words) but names no seed, fixture, demo, sample, mock, stub or story that shows it, and (b) a task that mentions removing (remove, delete, retire, rip out) across more than 20 paths (files plus new_files), with a message that asks for slices that each compile on their own. Put it in the new file checks_scope.rs (scope, live_without_seed, removal_too_wide) called from check_definition, with tests a_live_exercise_must_name_what_makes_it_appear and a_wide_removal_must_be_split_into_compiling_slices in checks_scope_tests.rs. Done when `scripts/cx nextest run -p mike --lib checks_scope` exits 0.

T5.name: Checks queue on their own checkout
T5.brief: Fleet reference task. Read .claude/fleet/project.md first. A clean check or ruling and a gate queue on one lock keyed on the repository's main checkout, although a gate runs in mike-gate and a clean check in mike-check, separate checkouts, so a one-second ruling waits behind a gate build. Make each queue on the checkout it uses: a gate on mike-gate, a clean check on mike-check, a command run in the shared tree on the repository, through a function checkout_used(repo, isolated) -> PathBuf in check_run.rs that gate_execution.rs also uses. Test: a_clean_check_and_a_gate_queue_on_their_own_checkouts_not_the_repository in check_run_tests.rs. Done when `scripts/cx nextest run -p mike --lib a_clean_check_and_a_gate_queue_on_their_own_checkouts_not_the_repository` exits 0.

T6.name: Slice report receipts stay small
T6.brief: Fleet reference task. Read .claude/fleet/project.md first. Each proof receipt in a fleet_report lists every path changed anywhere in the shared checkout since its command started; on a busy tree that was about 2,000 paths per receipt and a 16 MB report, which makes Claude Code drop the MCP connection. A receipt must keep the count (paths_changed_since_started; still_valid is unchanged) and a pointer to list_fleet_changes for the paths, not the paths. Fix launch/fleet/report_proof.rs. Test: a_busy_shared_tree_does_not_copy_its_changed_paths_into_every_receipt in report_proof_tests.rs. Done when `scripts/cx nextest run -p mike --lib a_busy_shared_tree_does_not_copy_its_changed_paths_into_every_receipt` exits 0.

observer.brief: A Rust reference run of six small tasks; watch build contention, the commit queue and the receipts.
